x.ASV: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Jehovah which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

nt: Hezekiah does not mean that the content of this message from Yahweh is objectively **good**. He means that he accepts and submits to what Yahweh has decided. You could indicate this explicitly in your translation if that would be helpful to your readers. The UST models one way to do that.

By **For he said**, Isaiah probably means that Hezekiah said it to himself. You could indicate this explicitly in your translation if that would be helpful to your readers. Alternate translation: [For he thought to himself]

If your language does not use abstract nouns for the ideas of **peace** and **stability**, you could express the same idea in another way. Alternate translation: [For my kingdom will be peaceful and stable in my days]
